fills.name: Bondi
fills.note: 100 max HP includes a displayed +10 bonus, so base is likely 90 (same convention as Longship 390/390 (+90))
fills.tieReason: s_00274: the bottom panel reads '100/100 (+10)' and the tooltip reads '100 TP'. The '(+10)' is a bonus applied on top of the base. The age indicator shows Age I (I. Zeitalter), and resolutions.json already records the +10 as a Spearwall bonus from being near other Bondi. So the unbuffed Bondi's base HP is 100 - 10 = 90, which matches the catalog's Dark Age Bondi hitpoints of 90. 100 is right only for a buffed variant, and this dispute's variant is null.

fills.name: Longship
fills.note: Empty-ship HP deduced as 390 - 90 (3 aboard x 30); Imperial Age, dock HP upgrades not ruled out
fills.tieReason: s_02066: the bottom panel reads '390/390 (+90)'. The Langschiff tooltip in the same frame says each non-villager on board adds +30 health ('+ Jeder Nicht-Dorfbewohner an Bord erhoeht die Gesundheit um +30'), and the ship shows 3/16 on board. 3 x 30 = 90, so the +90 comes from the units on board, not from an upgrade. The Longship's base HP is 300, which matches the catalog's 300. 390 is right only as a 'with 3 units on board' variant.
